The [[1932 Summer Olympics]], officially known as the Games of the X Olympiad, were an international [[multi-sport event]] held in [[Los Angeles]], California, United States, from July 30 to August 14.<ref>{{cite web |title=1932 Summer Olympics Overview |url=https://www.olympedia.org/editions/10 |website=[[Olympedia]] |access-date=February 20, 2025 |archive-date=September 7, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240907021155/https://www.olympedia.org/editions/10 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=FAQ: What are the Olympic Games? |url=http://olympic.ca/2019/02/08/faq-what-are-the-olympic-games/ |website=[[Canadian Olympic Committee]] |date=February 8, 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240805233326/http://olympic.ca/2019/02/08/faq-what-are-the-olympic-games/ |archive-date=August 5, 2024 |url-status=live |access-date=February 20, 2025}}</ref> A total of 1,334 athletes representing 37 [[National Olympic Committee]]s (NOCs) participated,<ref name="IOC LA 1932">{{cite web |title=Los Angeles 1932 Summer Olympics – Athletes, Medals & Results |url=https://www.olympics.com/en/olympic-games/los-angeles-1932 |website=[[International Olympic Committee]] |access-date=February 20, 2025 |archive-date=September 23, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240923172421/https://olympics.com/en/olympic-games/los-angeles-1932 |url-status=live }}</ref> including [[Colombia at the 1932 Summer Olympics|Colombia]] and the [[Republic of China at the 1932 Summer Olympics|Republic of China]], who took part for the first time.<ref name="Colombia IOC">{{cite web |title=Colombia – Profile |url=https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/colombia |website=[[International Olympic Committee]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241006042827/https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/colombia |archive-date=October 6, 2024 |url-status=dead |access-date=December 30, 2024 }}</ref><ref name="China IOC">{{cite web |title=China – Profile |url=https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/china |website=[[International Olympic Committee]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241006043922/https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/china |archive-date=October 6, 2024 |url-status=dead |access-date=December 30, 2024 }}</ref> The games featured 117 events in 14 [[Olympic sports|sports]] across 20 disciplines.<ref name="IOC LA 1932" /><ref>{{cite web |title=Los Angeles 1932 |url=https://www.olympics.com.au/games/los-angeles-1932/ |website=[[Australian Olympic Committee]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241007152951/https://www.olympics.com.au/games/los-angeles-1932/ |archive-date=October 7, 2024 |url-status=live |access-date=February 20, 2025 |language=en-AU}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Rao |first1=Rakesh |title=Games in the time of turmoil |url=https://sportstar.thehindu.com/rio-2016-olympics/olympics-history/games-in-the-time-of-turmoil/article8912316.ece |website=[[The Hindu]] |access-date=February 20, 2025 |language=en |date=July 28, 2016 |archive-date=June 25, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240625093410/https://sportstar.thehindu.com/rio-2016-olympics/olympics-history/games-in-the-time-of-turmoil/article8912316.ece |url-status=live }}</ref> The games also featured 9 medal events in various art competitions<ref name="arts">{{cite web |title=Art Competitions at the 1932 Summer Olympics |url=https://www.olympedia.org/editions/10/sports/ART |website=[[Olympedia]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250218094756/https://www.olympedia.org/editions/10/sports/ART |archive-date=February 18, 2025 |url-status=live |access-date=February 26, 2025}}</ref> [[Germany at the 1932 Summer Olympics|Germany]] was also awarded a gold medal in [[Alpinism at the Olympic Games|alpinism]] for a climb that took place before the games, which is counted in the official medal count.<ref>{{cite web |title=Alpinism at the 1932 Los Angeles Summer Games: Mixed Alpinism |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/summer/1932/ALP/mixed-alpinism.html |website=[[Sports Reference]] |access-date=February 26, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418132724/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/summer/1932/ALP/mixed-alpinism.html |archive-date=April 18, 2020 |url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Germany at the 1932 Summer Olympics |url=https://www.olympedia.org/countries/GER/editions/10 |website=[[Olympedia]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241225111116/https://www.olympedia.org/countries/GER/editions/10 |archive-date=December 25, 2024 |url-status=live |access-date=February 26, 2025}}</ref><ref name="Germany IOC">{{cite web |title=Germany – Profile |url=https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/germany |website=[[International Olympic Committee]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241006043234/https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/germany |archive-date=October 6, 2024 |url-status=dead |access-date=December 23, 2024}}</ref>

Athletes representing 28 NOCs received at least one medal, with 19 NOCs winning at least one gold medal.<ref name="IOC medal table" /> The [[United States at the 1932 Summer Olympics|United States]] won the most overall medals, with 110, and the most gold medals, with 44.<ref name="IOC medal table" /> Latvia and Mexico won their first Summer Olympic medals of any kind.<ref name="Latvia IOC">{{cite web |title=Latvia – Profile |url=https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/latvia |website=[[International Olympic Committee]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241006043608/https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/latvia |archive-date=October 6, 2024 |url-status=dead |access-date=December 30, 2024}}</ref><ref name="Mexico IOC">{{cite web |title=Mexico – Profile |url=https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/mexico |website=[[International Olympic Committee]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241204064240/https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/mexico |archive-date=December 4, 2024 |url-status=dead |access-date=December 30, 2024 }}</ref> Among individual participants, Italian fencer [[Giulio Gaudini]] (three silver, one bronze), Hungarian gymnast [[István Pelle]] (two gold, two silver), and Finnish gymnast [[Heikki Savolainen]] (one silver, three bronze) had the most total medals with four each.<ref name="Sports Reference">{{cite web |title=1932 Los Angeles Summer Games |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/summer/1932/ |website=[[Sports Reference]] |access-date=February 20, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200417041817/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/summer/1932/ |archive-date=April 17, 2020 |url-status=dead}}</ref> Italian gymnast [[Romeo Neri]] and American swimmer [[Helene Madison]] tied for the most gold medals, with three each.<ref name="Sports Reference" />

==Medal table==
[[File:Heikki Savolainen 1932 Olympics.jpg|thumb|right|alt=Heikki Savolainen competing on the uneven bars.|Finnish gymnast [[Heikki Savolainen]] won four medals at the 1932 games (one silver, three bronze), tied for the most among individual participants.<ref name="Sports Reference" />]]
[[File:Jānis Daliņš 2.jpg|thumb|right|alt=Jānis Daliņš shown from about the chest up in a suit jacket and tie.|Latvian race walker [[Jānis Daliņš]] won the first ever Olympic medal for Latvia, taking silver in the [[Athletics at the 1932 Summer Olympics – Men's 50 kilometres walk|men's 50 kilometres walk]].<ref name="Latvia IOC" />]]
The medal table is based on information provided by the [[International Olympic Committee]] (IOC) and is consistent with IOC conventional sorting in its published medal tables. The table uses the [[Olympic medal table]] sorting method. By default, the table is ordered by the number of gold medals the athletes from a nation have won, where a nation is an entity represented by a NOC. The number of silver medals is taken into consideration next and then the number of bronze medals.<ref>{{cite web |title=Olympic medal table: USA beat China to top spot at Paris 2024 |url=https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/olympics/olympics-2024-medal-table-count-paris-b2580716.html |website=[[The Independent]] | date=August 11, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240812015233/https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/olympics/olympics-2024-medal-table-count-paris-b2594580.html |archive-date=August 12, 2024 |url-status=live |last1=Ostlere |first1=Lawrence |access-date=August 12, 2024 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=A Medal Count That Adds Up To Little |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2008/08/19/sports/olympics/19araton.html |website=[[The New York Times]] | date=August 18, 2008 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230321004238/https://www.nytimes.com/2008/08/19/sports/olympics/19araton.html |archive-date=March 21, 2023 |url-status=live |last1=Araton |first1=Harvey |url-access=subscription |access-date=July 25, 2024 }}</ref> If teams are still tied, equal ranking is given and they are listed alphabetically by their [[List of IOC country codes|IOC country code]].<ref>{{cite web |title=What happens if two countries are tied in the Olympic medal table? Tiebreaker rules explained |url=https://en.as.com/olympic_games/what-happens-if-two-countries-are-tied-in-the-olympic-medal-table-tiebreaker-rules-explained-n/ |website=[[Diario AS]] |date=August 10, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240811152350/https://en.as.com/olympic_games/what-happens-if-two-countries-are-tied-in-the-olympic-medal-table-tiebreaker-rules-explained-n/ |archive-date=August 11, 2024 |url-status=live |last1=Cons |first1=Roddy |access-date=August 11, 2024 |language=en-us }}</ref>

The literature and paintings portion of the [[Art competitions at the 1932 Summer Olympics|arts competitions]] did not award a bronze medal, while the music event did not award bronze or gold, awarding only a silver medal.<ref name="arts" />

In [[Sailing at the 1932 Summer Olympics – 8 Metre|8 Metre sailing]], there were only two teams competing, which resulted in a bronze medal not being awarded in the event.<ref>{{cite web |title=Los Angeles 1932 8m mixed Results – Olympic sailing |url=https://www.olympics.com/en/olympic-games/los-angeles-1932/results/sailing/8m-mixed |website=[[International Olympic Committee]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241002000526/https://olympics.com/en/olympic-games/los-angeles-1932/results/sailing/8m-mixed |archive-date=October 2, 2024 |url-status=live |access-date=February 26, 2025}}</ref> In [[Equestrian at the 1932 Summer Olympics – Team jumping|equestrian team jumping]], no medals were awarded due to all involved teams failing to finish with enough riders to qualify for a medal.<ref>{{cite web |title=Gold, silver, bronze? Not in 1932 |url=https://www.cbc.ca/sports/2.720/gold-silver-bronze-not-in-1932-1.752142 |website=[[CBC Sports]] |date=May 15, 2008 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241211175830/https://www.cbc.ca/sports/2.720/gold-silver-bronze-not-in-1932-1.752142 |archive-date=December 11, 2024 |url-status=live |access-date=February 26, 2025}}</ref> In [[Equestrian at the 1932 Summer Olympics – Team eventing|equestrian team eventing]], only two teams finished, resulting in a bronze medal going unclaimed.<ref>{{cite web |title=Los Angeles 1932 team mixed Results – Olympic equestrian-eventing |url=https://www.olympics.com/en/olympic-games/los-angeles-1932/results/equestrian-eventing/team-mixed |website=[[International Olympic Committee]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241002000531/https://www.olympics.com/en/olympic-games/los-angeles-1932/results/equestrian-eventing/team-mixed |archive-date=October 2, 2024 |url-status=live |access-date=February 26, 2025}}</ref> In alpinism, only a gold medal and no silver or bronze medal were awarded.<ref>{{cite web |title=Alpinism at the 1932 Summer Olympics |url=https://www.olympedia.org/editions/10/sports/APN |website=[[Olympedia]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240901155344/https://www.olympedia.org/editions/10/sports/APN |archive-date=September 1, 2024 |url-status=live |access-date=February 26, 2025}}</ref>
